summary: Record primary native acceptance and remaining work for BUG-0093 through BUG-0096; BUG-0097 remains excluded. API impact: existing contracts exercised, with runtime changes assessed by their owning records.

guide.reason: This evidence/status update changes no operator steps; affected workflows are updated in the implementation records.

api.reason: The ledger and QA report record exercised contracts rather than introduce API behavior.

roadmap.reason: Individual regression evidence does not establish a whole phase acceptance gate.

state.reason: Documentation records observed results and adds no product state.

verification.method: Primary executed native sandbox, package enrollment/automatic ISO adoption/restart, libvirt health failure/recovery, discovery browser selection/registration, two-host QEMU locks, member NFS/SMB VM execution, access/peer failure recovery, generation catch-up, safe detach and fresh Controller replacement. Final full Go race suite, 159 Python tests, UI typecheck/tests/build, 20-outcome phase1 browser and nine-scenario storage browser suite passed. Independent review accepted the scoped slices; privacy, documentation and diff gates passed. No hosted CI, UEFI or whole-Phase-4 acceptance is claimed.
